description: 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부_우편통계 정보 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. 2018년 국내/국제우편물 물량/매출현황(일자, 우편구분, 물량, 증감률), 국가승인통계 21종, 시도별 통계 2종에 대한 정보입니다. 해당데이터가 보유한 컬럼은 다음과 같습니다. 자료는: 국내 물량 현황, 국내 매출액 현황, 국내 일반통상 현황, 국내 소포 현황, 국제 물량 현황, 국제 매출액 현황... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. Its tags are 국내 물량 현황, 국내 매출액 현황, 국내 일반통상 현황, 국내 소포 현황, 국제 물량 현황. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2025-07-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
